name: Crimson Surgeon
rules: Bloodied - Once per round, deal 1 damage to another friendly Moondemon. That creature gains +1 maximum HP permanently without restoring HP and +1 STR this round.
art_target: Crimson field-surgeon using claws and ritual needles to deliberately wound and strengthen an allied Moondemon.

name: Dusk Butcher
rules: Bloodied - When Dusk Butcher attacks a damaged enemy creature, it gains +2 STR for that combat.
art_target: Heavy dusk butcher advancing on a visibly wounded enemy, cleaver-like natural weapons brightening before impact.

name: Ravine Stalker
rules: Bloodied - When Ravine Stalker attacks a damaged enemy creature, it does not take retaliation damage from that combat.
art_target: Ravine predator slipping through an injured foe’s counterattack, shown in a low moonlit canyon stalking pose.

name: Pale Moon Tyrant
rules: Bloodied - The first time each round another friendly Moondemon becomes Bloodied, that creature gains +2 STR this round.
art_target: Pale tyrant watching another pack member become Bloodied, channeling a burst of strength into that ally.

name: Vespera, Redfang Matriarch
rules: Bloodied - The first time each round Vespera deals damage, you may redirect up to 2 HP of her universal restore to another friendly Moondemon. BLOODTHIRST - The Pack Drinks Together: the first Moondemon destroyed by Bloodthirst each round gives +3 STR / +3 maximum and current HP to every other friendly Moondemon instead of +2/+2. FRENZIED - Redline: the first time each round a Bloodied friendly Moondemon would return to full HP and be destroyed by Frenzied, deal 1 damage to it before the full-HP death check.
art_target: Legendary redfang matriarch towering over the pack beneath an eclipsed moon, crimson restore-lines visibly redirecting between hunters.

name: Blood Price
rules: Lose 2 Health. Gain 3 resources this round. Bloodied - If you control a Bloodied Moondemon, one Bloodied friendly Moondemon gains +2 STR this round.
art_target: Ritual payment scene: player-life represented as two red lunar coins burned away to release three resource sparks.

name: Pack Feeding
rules: Restore 2 HP to up to three friendly Moondemons. Bloodied - For each Bloodied target, you may replace 1 of that healing with +1 maximum HP permanently without restoring that point.
art_target: Several wounded pack members feeding together from one crimson lunar pool, healing choices visibly split between recovery and permanent growth.

name: Moonrage
rules: Bloodied - All Bloodied friendly Moondemons gain +2 STR this round. After each of those creatures takes a combat action, deal 1 damage to it.
art_target: Whole bloodied pack surging under a violent moon halo, every attacker empowered but burning itself after acting.

name: Predator's Reprisal
rules: When an enemy creature destroys one of your creatures, Bloodied - Choose another Bloodied friendly Moondemon. If it has not acted this round, it may immediately attack that enemy. After the attack, deal 1 damage to it.
art_target: A surviving bloodied hunter launching an immediate revenge strike at the creature that just killed its packmate.

name: Page of the Line
rules: Formation (1) - Page of the Line has +2 STR.
art_target: Young noble page standing alone on a marked formation line, visibly stronger because the lane belongs entirely to them.

name: Banner Squire
rules: Formation (2) - The other creature in this Formation has +0 STR / +1 maximum and current HP.
art_target: Banner-bearing squire bracing beside one partner, cloth standard physically sheltering the other fighter.

name: Twinblade Cadet
rules: Formation (2) - Twinblade Cadet has +2 STR / +1 maximum and current HP.
art_target: Cadet wielding paired blades in perfect two-person formation, stance opening only when a partner is present.

name: Oathguard
rules: Formation (3) - Oathguard has Taunt and +1 STR.
art_target: Armored oathguard anchoring a three-member line with shield forward and unmistakable Taunt posture.

name: Bastion Captain
rules: Formation (4) - The first damage dealt to a creature in this Formation each round is reduced by 2 before any Disperse split.
art_target: Veteran bastion captain at the center of a four-person shield wall, first impact dispersed across disciplined ranks.

name: Formation Adept
rules: Formation (3) - Formation Adept has +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP. The first time its Formation becomes exactly 3, draw 1 card, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.
art_target: Formation scholar-knight arranging exactly three fighters into a glowing tactical diagram while recording the result.

name: Relay Knight
rules: Formation (2) - The first time each round an Equip attached to a creature in this Formation grants a stat bonus or triggered effect, the other creature gains +1 STR this round.
art_target: Relay knight channeling the effect of one ally’s equipment across a two-person link to the other.

name: Bondwarden
rules: Formation (4) - At the start of your round, restore 2 HP divided among creatures in this Formation.
art_target: Protective bondwarden moving through a four-member formation and dividing restorative aid among the line.

name: Standard Marshal
rules: Formation (5) - Other creatures in this Formation have +1 STR.
art_target: Standard marshal raising a great heraldic banner over a five-member formation, all other fighters responding in unison.

name: Crowned Intercessor
rules: Formation (3) - Once per round, when another creature in this Formation is targeted by an attack, Crowned Intercessor may become the target instead.
art_target: Crowned intercessor stepping sideways into an incoming attack meant for another formation member.

name: United Colossus
rules: Formation (5+) - United Colossus has +1 STR for each other creature in this Formation, maximum +4 STR.
art_target: Massive armored colossus whose silhouette grows more imposing as additional formation members lock in around it.

name: First Among Equals
rules: Formation (1) - First Among Equals has +3 STR / +3 maximum and current HP. Formation (4) - Other creatures in this Formation have +1 STR / +1 maximum and current HP.
art_target: Elite lone champion standing apart with overwhelming presence, with a distant four-member formation echoing their authority.

name: Tighten Ranks
rules: Choose one Formation. Until end of round, its printed Formation effects may treat its size as exactly 1 higher or 1 lower. This does not count as a card joining and cannot activate Disperse or a Rise as One growth trigger.
art_target: Tactical overhead view of ranks compressing or expanding by one position without anyone actually joining.

name: Coordinated Strike
rules: Choose two creatures in the same Formation. If both attack the same enemy this round, the second attacker gains +3 STR for that combat.
art_target: Two formation allies striking the same enemy in timed succession, the second hit landing with amplified force.

name: Rotate the Line
rules: Choose two creatures in the same Formation. Move up to 2 damage from one onto the other. This cannot reduce the receiving creature below 1 HP.
art_target: Two armored allies rotating positions in the line while visible battle damage is transferred between them.

name: Rally Standard
rules: Choose a Formation. Its creatures gain +1 STR this round; if its Formation size is 4 or greater, they gain +2 STR instead.
art_target: A rally standard unfurling over a dense formation, larger groups receiving a visibly stronger martial surge.

name: Reinforce
rules: Summon two 1 STR / 1 HP Recruit creatures into open creature slots. Choose a Formation for each Recruit as it enters, or place it alone as Formation (1).
art_target: Two fresh recruits rushing into open formation slots, each choosing a place in the larger line.

name: Shared Purpose
rules: Choose a Formation. Until end of round, the first time one creature in it gains STR or HP from another friendly card effect, every other creature in that Formation gains +1 to the same stat this round.
art_target: Shared-purpose oath light jumping from one strengthened formation member to every other member in the same group.

name: Tower Shield
rules: Attach to a friendly Creature with no Equip. This Equip counts as 1 card in that creature's Formation. Formation (2) - Attached creature has Taunt.
art_target: Heavy physical tower shield with heraldic hardware and formation clasps; equipment portrait, not a character scene.

name: Oathblade
rules: Attach to a friendly Creature with no Equip. This Equip counts as 1 card in that creature's Formation. Formation (3) - Attached creature gains +2 STR for its first combat each round.
art_target: Ceremonial but battle-worn oathblade designed to lock into formation gear, glowing only on the wielder’s first combat.

name: Shieldmate Recruit
rules: Formation (2) - The first combat damage dealt each round to the other creature in this Formation is reduced by 1.
art_target: Shieldmate recruit leaning across a two-person line to blunt the first hit aimed at their partner.

name: Line Medic
rules: Formation (3) - At the start of your round, restore 2 HP to a creature in this Formation.
art_target: Line medic moving through a three-member formation with practical battlefield tools rather than magical healer robes.

name: Paired Lancer
rules: Formation (2) - Paired Lancer has +2 STR / +2 maximum and current HP.
art_target: Paired lancer driving forward beside exactly one partner, long weapon and interlocked footing emphasizing formation size two.

name: Formation Engineer
rules: Formation (4) - The first Equip you attach each round to a creature in this Formation costs 1 less, minimum 1.
art_target: Military engineer fastening equipment into a four-member formation, making the next attachment more efficient.

name: House Champion
rules: Formation (3) - Once per round, when another creature in this Formation would be destroyed by combat damage, deal 2 damage to House Champion. If House Champion survives, prevent 2 of that damage to the other creature.
art_target: House champion taking a punishing intercepting blow so another formation member survives.

name: High Marshal Caedryn
rules: Formation (5+) — The first time each round an Equip joins Caedryn's Formation, draw 1 card, then put 1 card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. WE STAND TOGETHER — No Empty Place: Caedryn's Formation gains Disperse at Formation 4+ instead of 5+, and the first time each round damage is dispersed there, reduce total damage by 2 before splitting it. RISE AS ONE. DIE AS ONE. — One Oath: the first time each round a card joins any Formation at size 2 or higher, the Rise growth for that addition is +2 STR / +2 maximum and current HP instead of +1/+1.
art_target: Legendary high marshal commanding a vast disciplined line, heraldry, equips, and formation geometry converging around one unmistakable leader.

name: Drill Standard
rules: Attach to a friendly Creature with no Equip. This Equip counts as 1 card in that creature's Formation. Formation (4) - When Drill Standard joins this Formation, all creatures in it gain +1 STR this round.
art_target: Rigid drill standard planted into a four-member formation as every fighter snaps into a sharper offensive posture.

name: Muster Horn
rules: Attach to a friendly Creature with no Equip. This Equip counts as 1 card in that creature's Formation. Formation (3) - At the start of your round, if you have an open creature slot, summon a 1 STR / 1 HP Recruit into this Formation. This normally changes the Formation to size 4.
art_target: Large muster horn with formation insignia sounding as a new recruit steps into the line from the background.

name: Banner of Seven
rules: Attach to a friendly Creature with no Equip. This Equip counts as 1 card in that creature's Formation. Formation (5+) - Creatures in this Formation have +0 STR / +1 maximum and current HP.
art_target: Grand seven-point banner hanging above a deep formation, protective heraldic structure reinforcing the entire group.

name: Take My Place
rules: Attach to a friendly Creature with no Equip. This Equip counts as 1 card in that creature's Formation. Formation (2) - Once per round, when the other creature in this Formation is targeted by an attack, the attached creature may become the target instead.
art_target: Interception harness/equipment showing one armored bearer physically swapping into the attack path of their formation partner.
